skip-signature-check.description: verifySignature returns true before looking at the header: any POST is processed, signed or not.
expectedFailures: rejects header without the sha256= prefix
a receiver with no APP_SECRET configured accepts nothing

no-inbox-dedupe.description: A conflict on the inbox row no longer stops processing: every redelivery calls the LLM again.
expectedFailures: honest side + a model that behaves
honest side + a model that echoes
honest side: the victim slot is confirmed
honest side: a model that fails every request

ledger-after-call.description: The llm_calls row is written after the LLM answers: a crash right after billing leaves no trace, and a simultaneous copy of the delivery, seeing an inbox row with no call, is processed and billed again.

text-outside-window.description: Any known customer gets a free-form text, however long ago they last wrote.

swallow-131047.description: A failed send (Graph API error or failed status webhook) is dropped: no record, no template fallback.

fallback-template-twice.description: outbound.fallback_of is not unique: a redelivered failed-status webhook sends a second template.

no-booking-unique.description: bookings.inbound_message_id is not unique: nothing in the database stops a second booking for one message.
